links.comparator_used: Baseline Clinical Prompt (generic prompt relying on the model's built-in knowledge)
links.outcome: Unsafe major error-free performance and exact guideline concordance in ASCCP risk-based management of abnormal cervical screening results (3 LLMs, 60 synthetic scenarios, 1080 observations)
links.effect: Guideline-directed prompt package associated with higher odds of unsafe major error-free performance (OR 3.76, 95% CI 2.45-5.77; P<.001) and exact concordance (OR 8.27, 95% CI 4.14-16.52; P<.001). Under the package, unsafe major error-free rate was 100% for GPT-5.3, 98.9% for Gemini 3 Flash, and 75% for DeepSeek V3.2.
links.tradeoff: Even with the package, the best-performing model remained vulnerable in complex, history-dependent scenarios; error rates rose from 3.1% in low-complexity to 29% in high-complexity scenarios. Most frequent errors were undermanagement, genotype misinterpretation, and history neglect.
links.quote: In the main-effects model, the guideline-directed prompt package was associated with higher odds of both unsafe major error-free performance (odds ratio [OR] 3.76, 95% CI 2.45-5.77; P<.001) and exact concordance (OR 8.27, 95% CI 4.14-16.52; P<.001).
